title: DeiT
paper_title: Training Data-Efficient Image Transformers & Distillation through Attention
core_mech: 增加 distillation token 和专用 head，使 CNN teacher 信号通过 Transformer attention 注入 ViT。
core_mech_en: Augments ViT with a learnable distillation token that interacts with patch tokens via self-attention to distill inductive biases from a CNN teacher.
input_desc: ImageNet/医学 2D 图像与训练时 CNN teacher logits
input_en: 2D image (plus CNN teacher hard predictions during training)
output_desc: class token 与 distillation token 融合的分类预测
output_en: Fused class-token and distillation-token classification prediction

source.title: DeiT
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: DeiT (distillation mechanism)
adapter.mechanism: timm distilled ViT has separate class/distillation tokens and heads; hard teacher targets supervise the distillation head.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Default teacher is an explicit analytic classifier of synthetic shape fill ratio, not the paper's pretrained RegNetY. Supply teacher_logits for a real teacher.
CPU dimensions differ from the paper's training preset; see the explicit configuration.
